text.tspan: Energy use per person vs. GDP
Energy refers to total energy supply, measured in
kilowatt-hours per person. Gross domestic product
(GDP) is adjusted for inflation and differences in living

tspan.tspan: GDP data is expressed in international-$ at 2021

text.tspan: prices. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from
the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is shown instead.
